formulas.name: Is_Running_User_Dept_Match
formulas.expression: OR( {!Get_Running_User.Profile.Name} = "System Administrator", {!Get_Running_User.Profile.Name} = "Utkarsh Admin", {!Get_Running_User.Profile.Name} = "CRM Head", {!Get_Running_User.Profile.Name} = "Utkarsh HOD", AND({!First_Dept} = "Crash Barrier", INCLUDES({!Get_Running_User.Departments__c}, "Crash_Barrier_Department")), AND({!First_Dept} = "High Mast & Polygonal", INCLUDES({!Get_Running_User.Departments__c}, "High_Mast_Department")), AND({!First_Dept} = "Solar Structure", INCLUDES({!Get_Running_User.Departments__c}, "Solar_Structure_Department")), AND({!First_Dept} = "Steel Pipes", INCLUDES({!Get_Running_User.Departments__c}, "Steel_Pipes_Department")), AND({!First_Dept} = "Steel Tubular Poles", INCLUDES({!Get_Running_User.Departments__c}, "Steel_Tubular_Pole_Department")), AND({!First_Dept} = "Transmission & Telecom Tower", INCLUDES({!Get_Running_User.Departments__c}, "Transmission_Tower_Department")) )

formulas.name: Mapped_Dept
formulas.expression: IF({!First_Dept} = "Crash Barrier", "Crash_Barrier_Department", IF({!First_Dept} = "High Mast & Polygonal", "High_Mast_Department", IF({!First_Dept} = "Solar Structure", "Solar_Structure_Department", IF({!First_Dept} = "Steel Pipes", "Steel_Pipes_Department", IF({!First_Dept} = "Steel Tubular Poles", "Steel_Tubular_Pole_Department", IF({!First_Dept} = "Transmission & Telecom Tower", "Transmission_Tower_Department", ""))))))
